The Item/List Phase 1 proposal is clear. `text-check` printed nothing, the title and the five to-dos read in ten seconds, and the checklist is short enough.

I made one fix: the owner's open calls pointed at `item-mvp/plan.md` as a bare path, so I made it a link in `requirements.md`. I logged one `rewrote` line in `flags.jsonl`.

I didn't open any page in a browser, since the proposal has no `page.js`.

The verdict is **fix**. The code for this merge (item 1, the `unset` verb) works, but the record-keeping around it doesn't: one doc wasn't updated and the merge gate left no record. The review is at `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/20/session-e00f55c9/item-phase1/review.md`.

**What works**
- `unset()` and `set({k: undefined})` both save one `{"unset":[k]}` line, and a replay clears the key. That holds for a full replay and for a snapshot plus the lines after it.
- `Task` records and list members read the line back correctly.
- `unset.test.mjs` passes in the worktree: 4 tests, 17 checks.
- The fences were kept: the failing test was committed first, and `marked_lines` is still off.

**Fixes**
1. `core/doc/status.md` still lists `unset` as "Not built" (lines 14 and 49). The brief's point 7 asks for it to be updated as each item lands.
2. The task folder has no result from `ReplayCompare` or `run-all.mjs` for this merge, so a fresh agent can't tell whether the gate passed. Both results need logging before the merge.

**Notes**
- On a Template, `Template.unset` overrides the new `Item.unset`. So clearing a field there saves no line, and a replayed line hands it an array. Templates are probably never stored, so the risk is low.
- `unset()` deletes keys directly instead of going through the class's own read/write methods. Two things are skipped: Panel mirrors' shared keys, and the change count `Ref` keeps for `path`/`url`. It's worth one sentence in the doc.
- Only item 1 is in this merge, which matches the one-merge-per-item rule. Items 2–5 are still open, and `plan.md` and the reset/epoch brief are enough for a fresh agent to carry on.

Message delivered to the mastermind. The task is complete and reported.

## Summary

**R4 fix for Item/List Phase 1** — a reader now recovers cleanly when its log is rewritten under it, in `worktree/item-reset` (3 commits: `f04a1711c`, `f2fcb472c`, `1402bf152`):

- **Server** (`Tail.js`): each socket's offset now carries proof (a gap check + a 256-byte window), so a rewrite — shorter, same-size, longer (compaction or migration shapes), or a rename-over — gets `jsonl_reset` instead of torn/repeated bytes. Test: `Tail.rewrite.test.mjs`, 10/10.
- **Client** (`Store.js`): `reset()`/`read()` now dedupe via a cheap hash multiset, so the full re-read after a reset applies only what's genuinely new — no verb runs twice — while a snapshot-started store freezes and warns instead of risking a silent double-apply. Test: `reset.test.mjs`, 8/8.
- **Validation:** `run-all.mjs` 215/216 (the one failure is a pre-existing, unrelated flake, confirmed on unmodified `main`); `ReplayCompare.mjs` — 4046/4046 records identical.
- **Doc:** `core/Item/doc/reset.md`, linked from the readme, covers the design, what's deliberately not caught, and the `epoch` alternative skipped.

Reported to `mastermind-item-phase1`; merging is theirs per the brief.

I passed this round. Both pieces work as asked: clearing a field (`unset`) and the warning for lines that name something that isn't there. Both test files pass in the worktree, 8 tests in all. The fixes from the last review are in place.

**What I checked**
- **Clearing a field:** clearing a field saves one line, and replaying the log gives the same result, whether from the start or from a snapshot plus the lines after it. That covers point 1 of the brief.
- **The warning:** it only warns and never refuses, and the value is still stored, so old logs read back the same. All 4,046 saved records came out identical in the replay comparison.
- **The checks before each merge:** both merges logged their results in `session.jsonl`. The full test run was 215 of 216 passing; the one failure is a known file-lock problem on Windows in a test that doesn't touch Item code.
- **Docs and folder:** `core/doc/status.md`, the Item readme and `doc/line-format.md` are all updated. A fresh agent could pick up the rest from `plan.md`.

**Notes (nothing that must change)**
1. In `core/doc/status.md`, the two new "done" sentences come right after "Built but off:", so a quick reader could think `unset` is switched off. Starting them with "Also done:" would fix that.
2. The brief asked for a warning on "unknown bare keys", but the check is narrower: it only covers lines inside a list. A key at the top level of a session or task file is never reported. The doc explains why: the broader check caught 27 keys, but only 4 of them were real problems.
3. Anything a line stores while running one of the item's methods is never reported, and that includes an explicit `set` line. So a newer writer's verb tucked inside a `set` line won't be caught. This is on purpose.
4. Scripts that replay every record will now print up to 4 warnings on today's data. That is expected, not a regression.

Points 3, 4 and 5 of the brief (`source` + `batch()`, recovery after a file is rewritten, merging keystrokes) aren't in this diff and are still open. The rewrite recovery is built by its own worker but not merged yet.

The review is at `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/20/session-e00f55c9/item-phase1/review.md`.

All review fixes are done and reported.

## Summary

Addressed all 10 review findings in `worktree/item-reset`, commit `f514b61a5`:

- **Fixed (1–6, 8, 9):** `live.js` now calls `read([])` on an empty post-reset frame so the Store's dedupe `skip` can't linger and swallow a later real append; a stale comment in `Store.js` and two stale docs (`ext/JSONL/doc/live.md`, `core/doc/status.md`) updated; a broken research link in `doc/reset.md` fixed; `Tail.js`'s rewrite-check cache now keyed by offset+proof (not offset alone); two new `reset.test.mjs` cases (empty-recovery-then-later-append, snapshot-freeze); `doc/reset.md` now documents the migration-front-ordering limitation.
- **Noted (7, 10):** already-honest doc caveat, and the requirements recheck — both resolved by the fixes above.

All 10 answered as `review.answer` lines in the task's `session.jsonl`; `reset.test.mjs` is now 14/14, `Tail.rewrite.test.mjs` 10/10, other suites still green. Reported to `mastermind-item-phase1`; not merged.

My verdict is **fix**: the merge for item 3 (`source` + `batch()`) needs one change. I wrote the review to `item-phase1/review.md`. No page changed, so it covers only the owner's asks and the words.

**What works:**
- **The asks are met.** The fold and `batch()` save one line per item per action. On a page edit, three changes now save two lines, and `Task.wait()` saves one line instead of eight. Both files replay to the same state as the live object.
- **Replay is unchanged.** ReplayCompare showed 4048 of 4048 records identical.
- **The test came first, and the fences held.** The failing test was committed before the code, `Store.marked_lines` was not touched, and nothing on disk changed.
- **A fresh agent can pick this up.** `plan.md` and the session log are enough to continue with item 5, merging keystrokes while typing.

**The one fix:**
- **`batch()` can lose lines without any warning.** While the function inside `batch()` is waiting (for example on an upload), its saved lines exist only in memory. If the tab closes or reloads during that wait, they are gone. Before this change they reached the outbox, which survives a reload, almost at once. The fix: save held lines when the page is hidden or closed, the same way held typing is already saved, and say so in `doc/batch.md`.

**Notes (worth a look, not blocking):**
- The test file says `Task.wait()` saved 7 lines before; the docs and log say 8.
- `core/doc/status.md` still says Phase 1 is "About half" done, though only typing coalesce and `Room` + `FileJournal` remain.
- The new `Item.source` getter sits between the `clock` getter and its setter in `Item.js`.
- Code that reacts to a line read from another tab now saves nothing to *any* file, not just its own. Today's reactions are fine, but the doc should say the mute is global.
- A dotted sub-key could replay in the wrong order after the fold. `set()` never produces one today, so nothing breaks yet.
- The full test run passed 218 of 219, which falls short of the brief's clean-run gate. The failure is a Servex whisper test that passes alone and touches no Item code; the landing line should record that exception.

My worktree checks happened after the diff was taken, and the worktree already contained item 5's typing code. I reviewed only the diff.

The review passes: the typing coalesce (merge 5 of the Item/List Phase 1 task) does what the brief asks. I made no code edits.

**Checked:**
- **Tests:** in the worktree, `coalesce.test.mjs` passes 5 of 5, including the blur case and the case where a different change has to go first. `batch.test.mjs` still passes 6 of 6.
- **Gates:** the session log for merge 5 records the test that failed before the fix (11 keystrokes saved 11 lines) and a replay comparison with 4,048 of 4,048 records identical.
- **Docs:** `core/doc/status.md`, `core/Item/readme.md` and `doc/batch.md` are updated. The new test file is linked from the readme, and I found nothing stale or missing from the indexes.
- **Limits:** the work stayed in its worktree, the marked-lines switch is still off, and no files on disk were changed.

**Four notes, none blocking:**
1. **Delayed saves:** in a browser, every single change is held for up to 300 ms, not just typing. A button that sets a field and then asks Servex to read that file straight away could read the old value. I found no code that does this today.
2. **Page hide:** when the page is hidden, held typing is sent one step later than held batch lines. Both should still go out before the page closes, but it would be cleaner if they used the same path.
3. **Test name:** the first test says "ten keystrokes" but types 11.
4. **Leaking setting:** `batch.test.mjs` turns the typing hold off and never turns it back on. That only matters if two test files ever run in one browser page.

The report is at `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/20/session-e00f55c9/item-phase1/review.md`.

I checked the Item/List Phase 1 task and rewrote the parts that failed; two "no picture" flags from `Server/text-check.mjs` remain. I did not shoot any pages.

- **Outcome:** the landed outcome is clear. It runs 107 words, and each of the five asks, plus the ReplayCompare and run-all gate, is ticked with a commit or test link.
- **Rewrites:** I split three over-60-word paragraphs in `plan.md` and `review.md` into short bullets. I edited these files directly because nobody owns the task any more.
- **Still flagged:** `plan.md` (266 words) and `review.md` (435 words) are text-only reports with no structure to draw, so I left them.
- **Skipped:** `task.jsonl` doesn't exist in this dir. The outcome sits in `session.jsonl`, so I checked that one. I also left out the `requirements.md` item 7 (update `core/doc/status.md` and the readmes) from the outcome's tick list; the review confirms it was done.
- **Log:** I appended one "rewrote" line to `.claude/skills/clarity/flags.jsonl`.
